integrity: Self-review passed for new claim. Computational checks supplement, not replace, the analytic proof. No independent audit, priority confirmation, human verification, or external certification has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem for two equal-rate exponential marginals coupled by the bivariate FGM survival copula only. Threshold has an exact infimum characterization; decimal approximations are noncertified and minimizer uniqueness is not asserted. The full earlier general copula-sum article DOI 10.1017/S0269964820000649 was inaccessible; equivalent past work cannot be excluded. The published IFR theorem is not contradicted.
title: Sharp log-concavity transition for FGM-coupled exponential sums
